hero.description: Oceania Cruises includes standard shipboard gratuities for stateroom stewards, butlers, and dining waitstaff in current Your World Included fares. Understand when 20% service charges apply, how historical daily rates compare, and whether extra cash tipping is expected.

editorialIntro.heading: Are Gratuities Included on Oceania Cruises?
paragraphs: Yes. Oceania Cruises includes standard shipboard gratuities in the cruise fare under its Your World Included program. This covers gratuities for stateroom and suite attendants, butlers, and dining waitstaff. Guests do not need to budget for a separate daily crew gratuity charge on qualifying current bookings.

However, not every service charge is included. Oceania generally adds a 20% service gratuity to certain onboard purchases, including beverages and spa services. Other optional expenses, such as shore excursions, premium beverages, and selected onboard services, may also increase the final cost of a cruise.
The important distinction is that standard crew gratuities are included in your ticket fare, while service charges associated with certain additional purchases may still apply.

includedGratuities.title: What Gratuities Are Included on Oceania Cruises?
intro: Oceania's Your World Included program incorporates standard crew gratuities into the cruise fare.
This means guests do not have to calculate and pay a separate daily crew tip for the core onboard service teams.

items.title: 1. Stateroom and Suite Attendants
paragraphs: Your stateroom or suite attendant maintains your private living quarters throughout the voyage, providing attentive twice-daily service.
Standard gratuities for stateroom attendants are completely covered under qualifying Your World Included cruise fares.
You will not see any daily room steward gratuities billed to your onboard folio.

lists.title: Included Steward Responsibilities
items: Daily morning cleaning, sanitizing, and stateroom refreshing
Evening turn-down service, pillow chocolates, and Currents schedule delivery
Refreshing plush towels and fine European bed linens according to schedule
Restocking Vero Water carafes, ice buckets, and bathroom amenities
Responding promptly to housekeeping and special laundry requests

items.title: 2. Dedicated Butler Service in Suites
paragraphs: Guests sailing in Penthouse Suites, Oceania Suites, Vista Suites, and Owner's Suites receive personalized 24-hour butler service.
Under current Your World Included fares, standard gratuities for your dedicated butler are fully incorporated into the cruise fare.
Guests do not need to settle a separate daily butler gratuity at the end of their sailing.

lists.title: Included Butler Services
items: Course-by-course in-suite dining service from specialty restaurant menus
Assisting with priority luggage unpacking and embarkation garment pressing
Coordinating priority reservations, spa appointments, and shore excursions
Delivering afternoon canapés, evening cocktails, and private veranda breakfasts
Packing assistance prior to debarkation and shoeshine services

items.title: 3. Restaurant Dining Waitstaff & Sommeliers
paragraphs: Oceania's dining teams are celebrated across the industry for delivering fine-dining European hospitality across all venues.
The included gratuities cover dining waitstaff, assistant waiters, head waiters, and maître d' teams in The Grand Dining Room and all signature specialty venues.
Guests enjoy open-seating flexibility and four-course specialty dinners without adding a tip to each meal check.

lists.title: Covered Dining Venues
items: The Grand Dining Room: open-seating breakfast, lunch, and multi-course dinner
Polo Grill Steakhouse: USDA Prime dry-aged steaks and Maine lobster service
Toscana: regional Italian pasta and tableside olive oil cart service
Jacques: French bistro cuisine curated by Master Chef Jacques Pépin
Red Ginger & Tuscan Steak: contemporary Asian and Italian steakhouse dining
Terrace Café buffet, Waves Grill poolside, and Horizon Lounge afternoon tea

tippingEtiquetteCards.title: The 20% Service Gratuity & Cash Tipping Etiquette
tippingEtiquetteCards.subtitle: CLEAR RULES ON EXTRA TIPPING & AUTOMATIC PERCENTAGE CHARGES

cards.title: How the 20% Purchase Gratuity Works
items: An automatic 20% service gratuity is applied to à la carte beverage orders, cocktail purchases, and spa/salon treatments.
For example, a $15 cocktail will have a $3 service charge added automatically to the bar chit (total $18).
A $200 massage at Aquamar Spa will incur an automatic $40 service charge (total $240 billed to folio).
Drinks ordered under the Complimentary Wine and Beer amenity carry zero extra service charges or percentage fees.
Purchasing the Prestige Select Beverage Package includes the service fee or applies it at checkout depending on promotion.

cards.title: Do You Need to Tip Extra in Cash?
items: Additional cash tipping is completely optional and never expected on Oceania Cruises.
Crew members receive their fair share of standard gratuities through the Your World Included program.
Guests who receive exceptional or personalized care may voluntarily present a modest cash tip on the final evening.
Common occasions for extra tips: complex butler concierge requests, personalized cocktail preparation, or special baggage handling.
Do not feel pressured to tip extra cash—your cruise fare has already taken care of the onboard service team.

verificationChecklist.title: 6-Point Pre-Cruise Gratuity Verification Checklist
verificationChecklist.subtitle: HOW TO VERIFY YOUR FARE INCLUSIONS BEFORE EMBARKATION

steps.title: 1. Confirm Booking Date & Promotion
steps.description: Verify whether your reservation was booked under Your World Included (where standard gratuities are bundled) or an earlier promotional fare.

steps.title: 2. Check Your Sailing Confirmation
steps.description: Review your booking invoice and guest confirmation documents to ensure standard crew gratuities are listed as included.

steps.title: 3. Review Your Selected Amenity
steps.description: Confirm whether you selected Complimentary Wine & Beer or the Shore Excursion Credit ($400–$1,200) prior to your final payment deadline.

steps.title: 4. Understand the 20% Purchase Policy
steps.description: Familiarize yourself with the 20% service charge on à la carte alcoholic drinks and spa treatments so your onboard budget is accurate.

steps.title: 5. Prepare Local Currency for Shore Guides
steps.description: Keep small bills in euros, pounds, or dollars for local tour guides and motorcoach drivers, as they are not cruise line employees.

steps.title: 6. Monitor Your Onboard Folio
steps.description: Check your folio periodically on the Oceania mobile app or at Guest Services to ensure all charges reflect your actual onboard purchases.

expertTips.title: Expert Tips for Navigating Oceania Gratuities
expertTips.subtitle: INSIDER ADVICE FROM CERTIFIED CRUISE SPECIALISTS

items.title: No Need to Add Meal Tips
items.description: Waitstaff tips in The Grand Dining Room and specialty restaurants are completely covered. Never feel obligated to write tips on meal slips.

items.title: Budget for the 20% Bar Gratuity
items.description: If ordering cocktails or premium cellar wines à la carte, remember the 20% service charge will be automatically added to your bill.

items.title: Check Spa Treatment Totals
items.description: Spa quotes generally exclude the mandatory 20% service charge. Add 20% to listed treatment prices when planning wellness budgets.

items.title: Cash Tips Are Strictly Discretionary
items.description: Crew members do not expect cash tips. Only offer extra cash if an attendant or butler went far above and beyond expectations.

items.title: Carry Cash for Shore Excursions
items.description: Local tour guides and drivers ashore are independent contractors. Customary tips ($5–$10 per person) should be paid in local currency.

items.title: Prestige Select Includes Bar Tips
items.description: Purchasing the Prestige Select package covers bar service fees on included drinks, eliminating individual 20% charges per glass.

items.title: Wine Amenity Drinks Incur Zero Tip
items.description: Wines and beers poured under the Complimentary Wine and Beer amenity carry zero extra service gratuities on qualifying pours.

items.title: Avoid Tipping Room Service Extra
items.description: Complimentary 24-hour in-room dining is serviced by onboard staff covered under the standard gratuity program.

items.title: Verify Older Booking Invoices
items.description: If traveling on a rescheduled or older booking made prior to Your World Included, confirm whether historical daily fees apply.

items.title: Review Folio Before Debarkation
items.description: Review your final stateroom folio on debarkation morning to ensure all billed 20% gratuities match your actual onboard orders.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Oceania Cruises Gratuities
faqs.subtitle: EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW ABOUT TIPPING, CREW CHARGES & POLICIES

questions.question: Are gratuities included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Standard gratuities for stateroom and suite attendants, butlers, and dining waitstaff are included in qualifying current cruise fares under Your World Included.

questions.question: How much are gratuities on Oceania Cruises per day?
questions.answer: For qualifying current bookings, standard shipboard gratuities are included in the cruise fare, so there is no separate daily crew gratuity amount to budget. Historically, daily rates were $18/day for standard categories and $23/day for suites.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises charge a 20% gratuity?
questions.answer: Yes. A 20% service gratuity generally applies to qualifying onboard purchases, including à la carte beverages and spa services.

questions.question: Do I need to tip my Oceania cabin steward?
questions.answer: No additional tip is required for standard cabin service because the applicable crew gratuity is already included in qualifying current fares. An extra cash tip is optional.

questions.question: Are butler tips included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. For eligible suites with butler service (Penthouse Suites and above), standard butler gratuities are fully included under the current Your World Included arrangement.

questions.question: Are dining room tips included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Standard gratuities for dining waitstaff are included in qualifying current cruise fares across all main dining venues and specialty restaurants.

questions.question: Are specialty restaurant gratuities included?
questions.answer: Standard dining gratuities are included, and Oceania's regular specialty restaurants (Polo Grill, Toscana, Jacques, Red Ginger, Tuscan Steak) are part of the cruise fare. Certain exclusive experiences like La Reserve carry extra charges.

questions.question: Can I prepay gratuities on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Standard crew gratuities are already included in qualifying current bookings. Guests with older reservations should check their booking confirmation to determine whether any gratuities were prepaid or need settling separately.

questions.question: Are gratuities included in Oceania's cruise fare?
questions.answer: Yes. Oceania includes standard shipboard gratuities as part of its Your World Included program for qualifying current bookings.

questions.question: Is the 20% gratuity included in the cruise fare?
questions.answer: No. The 20% service gratuity on applicable additional onboard purchases (such as bar drinks and spa treatments) is separate from standard crew gratuities included in the fare.

questions.question: Are beverage gratuities included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Standard crew gratuities are included, but an automatic 20% service gratuity generally applies to chargeable beverage purchases. Complimentary beverage amenities are poured without service fees.

questions.question: Are spa gratuities included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: The standard shipboard crew gratuity is included in the fare, but an automatic 20% service gratuity applies to qualifying spa and salon treatments.

questions.question: Do I need to tip extra on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: No. Additional tipping is strictly optional. You may choose to recognize exceptional service with an extra cash tip on the final evening, but it is never required or expected.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises include gratuities for solo travelers?
questions.answer: Yes. Standard shipboard gratuities are included for all qualifying guests, including solo travelers booked in Solo Veranda or standard categories.

questions.question: Are gratuities included on Oceania world cruises?
questions.answer: Standard shipboard gratuities are included on qualifying current bookings, including eligible longer voyages and World Cruise segments.

questions.question: Are Oceania Cruises gratuities refundable?
questions.answer: Standard gratuities included in the cruise fare are not treated as a separate refundable daily item. For disputed onboard purchases, consult Guest Services prior to disembarkation.

questions.question: Can I remove the 20% gratuity from an onboard purchase?
questions.answer: The treatment of purchase-related service gratuities is governed by Oceania's legal terms. If you experience unsatisfactory service on a specific purchase, speak with Guest Services to review the charge.

questions.question: Are gratuities included in Oceania's complimentary wine and beer amenity?
questions.answer: Yes. Wine and beer poured under the Complimentary Wine and Beer amenity during lunch and dinner carry zero additional service charges or gratuity fees.

questions.question: Are gratuities included in Oceania's shore excursion credit?
questions.answer: Standard shipboard crew gratuities are included in qualifying cruise fares. Shore excursion credit applies to tour tickets; tips for local step-on guides and drivers ashore remain discretionary cash expenses.

questions.question: Where can I find Oceania Cruises' official gratuity policy?
questions.answer: The most reliable sources are Oceania's official Your World Included page, its support center gratuity FAQs, and the Guest Ticket Contract attached to your reservation.
